name: Turkcell TV+ 4K Box
summary: Turkcell TV+ 4K Box ships with telemetry, recommendations and operator auto-installs. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with backup and undo.
intro: This Turkcell operator streaming box is a Google-certified Android TV with a standard home screen. It ships with telemetry, log collection and factory test tools, recommendations, operator customisation and auto-installs, and a few preloaded apps. Each app has its own switch in the app, so you decide which ones to turn off.

It was tested on one box the same day, including several reboots. It is a streaming box with no HDMI-in or tuner. Each computer is accepted on screen with a debugging prompt, and sideloading works. TidyTV turns these apps off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything.
keep: The remote's app buttons, handled by the global key service

notes: Network debugging asks you to allow the connection on screen.
The remote's YouTube, Play Store and TV+ buttons are handled by one key service.

faq.q: Can I get the old home screen back on my Turkcell TV+ 4K Box?
faq.a: Yes. Restore everything in the app turns every app back on and puts the old home screen back in one tap. TidyTV only switches apps off, so nothing is ever deleted.

faq.q: Will the remote's YouTube and TV+ buttons still work?
faq.a: Yes. They are handled by a key service that is kept on.

faq.q: Does TidyTV delete anything on my Turkcell TV+ 4K Box?
faq.a: No. It turns apps off with Android's own setting, saves a backup first and checks each one. You can turn any app back on with its switch.
